secEdgair_agentAttribution.reasoning: Add temporal query helpers, snapshot registry, and validation rules on top of existing base.financial_facts. No new tables — this is an ergonomic layer for downstream consumers.

documentation.description: Provides temporal query helpers (current_facts, as_known_on, fact_history, compare_periods, facts_at_snapshot), snapshot registry (get_labeled_snapshots, find_snapshot_at, snapshot_diff_summary), and 5 temporal DQ validation rules (BASE-BT-001 through BASE-BT-005). Operates on existing base.financial_facts table — no new Iceberg tables created.

facets.description: Denormalized financial facts with bitemporal markers (filed_date, is_superseded, superseded_by, promoted_at)
facets.usage: Read-only — queries and validation operate on existing data
